name: Sandhaven Caravan Park
stayType: Seafront caravan park with touring pitches
accommodation: Touring pitches, holiday hire and holiday homes for sale
beachAccess: Direct beach access; a step from a Blue Flag beach
confirmedFeatures: On-site wardens, refurbished shower and toilet block, near the promenade and Ocean Road
overview: A Northumbrian Leisure park on the South Shields seafront with direct access to the beach. It offers touring pitches and holiday hire, and the promenade, Ocean Road and its restaurants are around five minutes' walk. The season runs for most of the year.
surfTripFit: Direct beach access and touring pitches make it a straightforward base for campervan surf trips.
